name: cordis-europa
description: CORDIS (EU research results portal): look up EU-funded research projects and their reports, deliverables, OpenAIRE publications, Results-in-Brief and news articles, browse news and domain-of-application listings, and run keyword searches over the Projects Map data.

commands.name: get-project
commands.summary: Get the full fact sheet of an EU research project (Horizon Europe, H2020, FP7…) as JSON, looked up by grant agreement ID

commands.name: get-project-reporting
commands.summary: Get a project's periodic or final report summary: context and objectives, work performed, and results so far

commands.name: list-project-deliverables
commands.summary: List a project's public deliverables, data management plans and publications, with download links (from the project's Results tab)

commands.name: get-project-openaire
commands.summary: Get the publications, datasets, software and other research outputs that OpenAIRE links to a project

params.name: project_id
params.description: Grant agreement / project ID (sent as rcn together with paramType=id)

commands.name: get-result-report
commands.summary: Get a result/report record as JSON (periodic report summary, work performed, final results, related project), looked up by its RCN

params.name: rcn
params.description: CORDIS record number (RCN) of the result, e.g. 1169591

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Get a CORDIS article (news, Results in Brief, Ask an expert…) as JSON, including body, keywords and related projects/articles

params.name: id
params.description: Article id with slug as it appears in article URLs, e.g. 467900-can-birds-understand-the-songs-of-other-species

commands.name: list-news
commands.summary: List the latest CORDIS news articles shown on the news hub, by section (Scientific advances, Ask an expert…)

commands.name: list-domain-articles
commands.summary: List recent articles for a domain of application (Energy, Health, Digital Economy, Climate Change and Environment, …)

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain slug, e.g. energy, digital-economy, climate-change-and-environment (the lowercase, hyphenated domain name)

commands.name: search-projects-map
commands.summary: Keyword search over EU-funded projects and participating organisations (Projects Map data): returns hit counts plus organisations with address, coordinates and their projects (budget, dates, scheme);

commands.name: get-data-extraction-api-spec
commands.summary: Get the OpenAPI spec of the CORDIS Data Extraction Tool API (bulk extractions; using the API needs a personal API key)

notes: robots.txt disallows /search and /programme/id/*, so the site's main keyword search, its filters, sort orders, pagination and framework-programme pages are not exposed. Use search-projects-map for keyword search instead.

search-projects-map returns two fields, 'number' and 'content'. Both are JSON-encoded strings, so parse them a second time. 'number' holds totals and budget/date ranges. 'content' maps organisation IDs to {name, country, city, lat, lon, projects{projectId: {...}}}.
The web app also sent search-projects-map queries such as 'hydrogen&&&2' and 'hydrogen&&&3' to get further result chunks or views. To try these, append '&&&N' to --query.

IDs: projects use the grant agreement ID (e.g. 101070320). Result reports use an RCN (e.g. 1169591), found in a project's relations or on its reporting page. Articles use 'rcn-slug' ids (e.g. 467900-can-birds-understand-the-songs-of-other-species), found in list-news, list-domain-articles or a project's relations.
Project fact sheets can also be exported as XML (?format=xml) and fetched in other languages at /project/id/{id}/{lang} (de, en, es, fr, it, pl).
Bulk datasets of all Horizon Europe and H2020 projects (CSV/JSON/XML) are on data.europa.eu, not on CORDIS itself.
The Data Extraction Tool endpoints (/api/dataextractions/*) need a personal API key from a CORDIS account, so they are not wrapped here.
The SPARQL endpoint (EURIO Knowledge Graph) exists, but no query was recorded, so it is not wrapped.
Not wrapped because the recording did not give enough detail: per-project news (/project/id/{id}/news) and the thematic-packs listing.
get-project-widget is based only on the explorer's summary: its exact parameters and response were not recorded.

get-project and list-domain-articles were not fully verified against the recording. For get-project, only the HTML fact sheet's structure was recorded, so the JSON fields of the export are unknown. For list-domain-articles, the extract selectors come from a truncated page outline.

dropped.summary: Get the embeddable project widget data for a project (JSONP, returned as raw text)
